conceptualMapping: For completeness, and to leave a real design trail rather than an empty placeholder: every one of Section 3's own named semantic roles already has a direct, existing IR-level counterpart in the CURRENT single-pass architecture, which is itself evidence Option 1 is sufficient - BASE_VALUE/ADDITION/SUBTRACTION=ADD/SUM/SUBTRACT operands; THRESHOLD/CAP/FLOOR=MAX/MIN operands or a COMPARE right-hand side; RATIO_NUMERATOR/RATIO_DENOMINATOR=DIVIDE's own numerator/denominator; CONDITION=IRCondition; EXCEPTION=IRException; PERMISSION/PROHIBITION/REQUIREMENT=IRRule.posture; ALTERNATIVE=MAX/MIN or an IF branch; TIER=SCHEDULE.cases; TRIGGER=EVENT_ACTIVE.triggerCondition; TIME_PERIOD=DURING_PERIOD/activeDuration; RECLASSIFICATION=IRRuleDependency; SHARED_CAP_REFERENCE=LEDGER_USAGE_REFERENCE.sharedCapRef; DEPENDENCY=IRRule.dependsOn/IRDefinition.dependsOnTerms; DEFINITION_REFERENCE=DEFINED_TERM_REFERENCE; CURE=EVENT_ACTIVE+activeDuration; PAYMENT_PRIORITY=SCHEDULE or ordered IRRule sequencing; OTHER_SEMANTIC_COMPONENT=UNSUPPORTED (now attemptedStructure-preserving).
